name: unhcr-refugees-mcp-server
description: Query UNHCR refugee, IDP, and stateless populations, asylum decisions, returns, and resettlement.

UNHCR_MAX_ROWS.title: Row cap per call
UNHCR_MAX_ROWS.description: Most upstream rows one tool call fetches; a larger result stops at the cap and reports complete: false.

UNHCR_CACHE_MAX_MB.title: Response cache (MB)
UNHCR_CACHE_MAX_MB.description: Response-cache budget in MB; 0 disables the cache.

UNHCR_DATASET_TTL_SECONDS.title: Dataframe TTL (seconds)
UNHCR_DATASET_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long a staged dataframe lives, in seconds (minimum 60).

UNHCR_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.title: Enable dataframe drop
UNHCR_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.description: Register unhcr_dataframe_drop. Off by default; the TTL reclaims staged tables.
